issue.title: Block UI doesn't appear, cant use a majority of the blocks.
issue.body:
### Description

Been having this issue, cant pinpoint what could be wrong. If this is an issue with another mod, please tell me because I cant ask on the discord server because its constantly failing to accept the invite no matter how much I try.

Basically, the UI that pops up on some of the blocks to change or activate a GUI don't appear. This is most noticeable on the creative motor, preventing me from changing its speed at all.

I'll see if i can upload the recording of this being demonstrated but nothing wants to work with me and it keeps failing to upload :(
